title: 5-Minute Masala Omelette
setting: a cozy home kitchen with a black cast-iron pan on a gas stove

scenes.narration: This is the fastest, fluffiest masala omelette you will ever make. Five minutes, one pan.
scenes.image_prompt: a golden fluffy masala omelette folded on a plate, flecks of green chili and coriander, steam rising, hero shot

scenes.narration: You need two eggs, half an onion, one green chili, a little tomato, fresh coriander, salt, and a pinch of turmeric.
scenes.image_prompt: overhead flat lay of two eggs, chopped red onion, green chili, diced tomato, coriander leaves, small bowls of salt and turmeric on a wooden board

scenes.narration: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add everything, and whisk until it turns light and frothy.
scenes.image_prompt: eggs being whisked in a ceramic bowl with chopped onion, chili and coriander, frothy texture, action shot

scenes.narration: Heat a teaspoon of butter on medium. Pour it in, and gently swirl the pan.
scenes.image_prompt: egg mixture being poured into a sizzling buttered cast-iron pan, bubbles forming at the edges

scenes.narration: Cover and cook for two minutes, until the top is just set.
scenes.image_prompt: omelette cooking in a covered pan with a glass lid, steam on the lid, soft golden edges

scenes.narration: Fold it in half, slide it onto a plate, and serve hot with buttered toast. Save this for tomorrow's breakfast!
scenes.image_prompt: folded masala omelette on a plate next to buttered toast and a cup of chai, morning light
